title: Two Littlewood identities for fully inhomogeneous spin Hall-Littlewood symmetric rational functions
summary: Fully inhomogeneous spin Hall-Littlewood symmetric rational functions $F_λ$ arise as partition functions of certain path configurations in the $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ higher spin six vertex models. They are multiparameter generalizations of the classical Hall-Littlewood symmetric polynomials. We establish two new generalizations of the classical Littlewood identity, where we express a weighted sum of $F_λ$'s over all partitions $λ$ as a product of the Littlewood kernel and another simple product in one case, and a product of the Littlewood kernel and a Pfaffian in the other case.
